title: 沃勒担忧成真：核心CPI触及0.3%，他会支持12月加息吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Michael McKee giving those numbers to us right now as they cross Mike.
segments.zh: Michael McKee 刚刚向我们发布了这些数据。

segments.en: Well, it looks like we have a concern for Chris Waller because we see both the headline and this core come in higher than expected for the month of October.
segments.zh: 看来 Chris Waller 有理由担忧，因为10月份整体和核心数据都高于预期。

segments.en: The headline comes in up four tenths. The core comes in up three tenths and remember Chris Waller said that he would be concerned if it came in around three tenths again.
segments.zh: 整体数据上涨0.4%，核心上涨0.3%。记住，Chris Waller 曾表示，如果核心再次在0.3%左右，他会感到担忧。

segments.en: So we'll have to check back with him. Hopefully it'll give us a call or something while we're doing this.
segments.zh: 所以我们得回头找他确认。希望他能在我们直播时来个电话。

segments.en: Now we don't get a year over year number of course because the CPI in October of 2025 wasn't
segments.zh: 当然，我们拿不到同比数据，因为2025年10月的CPI没有进行。

segments.en: conducted but I can give you some of the breakdown of the numbers here very quickly.
segments.zh: 但我可以很快给大家一些数据细分。

segments.en: We're looking at food at home up by four tenths and food overall up by five tenths which
segments.zh: 我们看到家庭食品上涨0.4%，整体食品上涨0.5%，这

segments.en: is a concern that could reflect tariffs and that could reflect energy prices.
segments.zh: 是一个担忧点，可能反映关税影响，也可能反映能源价格。

segments.en: Energy prices up seven tenths gasoline was up by one percent during the month.
segments.zh: 能源价格上涨0.7%，汽油本月上涨1%。

segments.en: Electricity up nine tenths and then in terms of commodities less food and energy.
segments.zh: 电力上涨0.9%，然后剔除食品和能源的商品。

segments.en: In other words, goods prices up two tenths on the month.
segments.zh: 换句话说，商品价格环比上涨0.2%。

segments.en: Service prices up three tenths. New vehicles up two tenths.
segments.zh: 服务价格上涨0.3%。新车价格上涨0.2%。

segments.en: Use cars do fall 1.2 percent and a peril was up a tenth.
segments.zh: 二手车价格下降1.2%，而服装价格上涨0.1%。

segments.en: I'll look at some of the other numbers that Chris Waller was concerned about and get back to you in a little bit.
segments.zh: 我将查看克里斯·沃勒担心的其他一些数据，稍后回复你。
